description: This PHP class defines a data transfer object (DTO) for filtering employee education search results, extending a base filter params class, with functionality to set and retrieve an employee number and a default sort field.

classes.name: EmployeeEducationSearchFilterParams
classes.description: A DTO used for filtering employee education search results, including an employee number filter and sorting capabilities.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the filter parameters with a default sort field 'e.name'.

methods.name: getEmpNumber
methods.description: Returns the employee number filter, if set.
